bsi.editorial_reason: Restore the direct inherited key name Nebo in the Ezra returnee-community context without identifying the site with another Nebo namesake.
editorial_evidence: Ezra 10:43 in the pinned WLC explicitly names the 'sons of Nebo' (o150100430021); the register denotes the community of the named settlement, not Mount Nebo, while the geographical interpretation is preserved as a source qualification.
